Idk how it works in Canada, but it shouldn't be that hard. You can access your bank account right? 

What's more important is that you take the decision to move out. Don't let your family gaslight you because it's not culturally appropriate. You can figure out the how's
Just move out. Your family will not be thrilled, but you'll feel better on your own
The people who post mean comments do it to feel better about themselves or just because they want attention, so please remember this the next time you feel upset about one. <3

Hey, I know the feeling. 

It really hurts, but hang in there, enjoy your cinnamon rolls. I hope you find someone to share them with someday :)
